releases.name: claude-smart 0.3.15
releases.body:
Fix Codex hook failures caused by generated dependency symlinks in the plugin cache. Python and dashboard dependencies now live in an account-scoped runtime outside the validated plugin package. Updates preserve runtime reuse, and uninstall stops runtime services before cleanup.

Update using `npx --yes claude-smart@0.3.15 update --host codex` with the same `CODEX_HOME` as your session.

Validated with local tests, real Codex hook discovery, cross-platform CI, and local/GitHub Codex review.

releases.name: claude-smart 0.3.12
releases.body:
Claude-smart 0.3.12 improves local learning defaults and installation summaries.

- Claude Code background learning uses the `sonnet` family alias instead of pinning a model version or inheriting the coding model. Explicit learning models remain supported.
- Codex and OpenCode retain their configured defaults.
- Install, update and setup report the Claude-smart version, learning provider, provider CLI version and model selection. Unreported resolved model versions remain explicitly unknown.
- Custom executables and cloud-provider opt-outs are preserved.

Managed Reflexio continues to select its model on the server; the local Sonnet default applies to local Claude Code learning.

Update with `npx claude-smart@0.3.12 update`. Claude Code: run `/reload-plugins` or use the next session. Codex: start a new session to activate the updated plugin.

releases.name: claude-smart 0.3.11
releases.body:
Claude-smart 0.3.11 bundles the latest merged Reflexio source and improves learning from short sessions.

- Claude Code sends an optional session-completion signal, including when messages were already published. Automatic processing retains the usefulness judge.
- The bundled backend supports a configurable six-hour inactivity fallback for pending messages, including publish-only integrations.
- Completion remains durably accepted if a local scheduler wakeup fails.

Managed Reflexio requires the corresponding #1765 backend deployment to enable completion processing and inactivity fallback. Older managed backends continue normal publishing/retrieval and safely reject unsupported completion signals; updating the plugin does not deploy or migrate the cloud backend.

Update: `npx claude-smart@0.3.11 update`

Claude Code: `/reload-plugins` or the next session. Codex: start a new session to activate the new plugin version.

releases.name: claude-smart 0.3.10
releases.body:
## Dashboard style refresh

Align claude-smart with the managed Reflexio workspace style across Dashboard, Sessions, Preferences, Skills, and Configure:

- Neutral light/dark surfaces and green accents replace the cyan palette and decorative grid.
- Overview metrics form a responsive band with thin dividers.
- Page headers, lists, details, and settings share aligned responsive gutters.
- Sidebar navigation, Configure tabs, empty states, and controls use a quieter, flatter style.
- Mobile navigation has an accessible name, and active sidebar links identify the current page.

Includes #187. Existing data-source, retrieval, editing, and configuration behavior is preserved. No dependency changes; retain the bundled Reflexio 0.2.30 revision.

releases.name: claude-smart 0.3.9
releases.body:
- Replace the dashboard header's input-like endpoint box with a plain “Backend: …” label that shows the configured host and port.
- Add “Open cloud dashboard” for Managed Reflexio; Local mode has no cloud link. Connection settings remain under Configure.
- Remove the logo's button-like frame and background so it reads as branding.

Includes #185. No dependency changes; the existing bundled Reflexio 0.2.30 revision is retained.
